Silk Press Appointments Near Oakland, CA

What is a silk press?

A silk press is a temporary hairstyle that uses tools and techniques such as a flat iron and deep conditioning to straighten natural hair and create a silky, soft, and bouncy appearance.

How much does a silk press cost?

The cost of a silk press ranges from $65 to $175.

Price estimates are provided for informational purposes only and do not constitute an offer to purchase services at the estimates stated. Please contact your StyleSeat Professional for pricing details on your selected service.

How much should you tip for your silk press?

Tipping 20 percent of the total cost for your silk press appointment is the best rule of thumb to follow. Consider varying your tip based on the cleanliness of the stylist’s working area, their friendliness, and your satisfaction with the results.
